observations: The list of misprints, p. [237], without a page number; the contents (p. [III], JP2 0007) give pp. 233-237 for the additions and corrections. The heading «Druckfehler.» (L01) in bold, below the upper third of the page, and the remark in parentheses (L02), centred; then the list, each entry beginning with «Pag.» or a long dash for it and the page, right-aligned, followed in L19-L20 by no comma; a second long dash (L09) stands for the page 26 of the entry before. Here the entries in three columns, «Pag.», the page and the correction, separated by our «|»; L06 and L18 continue the entries of L05 and L17 under their text. At the foot of the list a short double rule, centred; not transcribed. The rest of the page is blank. Italics: «sed supra», «scrips.», «supra» (L05-L06).

The entries, checked against the places they correct, counting the lines of the text without the footnotes, as L02 says: p. 3, note 32 (JP2 0035, N10-N11; critical note AK07-CN278); p. 6, the 10th line from the foot, L20 (JP2 0038; AK07-CN016); p. 17, note 8 (JP2 0049, N04; AK07-CN279); p. 22, L09 (JP2 0054; AK07-CN036); p. 26, the last line, L28, and the last line of the notes, N17 (JP2 0058; AK07-CN044, AK07-CN280, AK07-CN045); p. 26, the 8th line from the foot, L21 (AK07-CN043); p. 31, L15 (JP2 0063; AK07-CN281); p. 49, the 11th line from the foot, L29 (JP2 0081; AK07-CN282); p. 50, the 7th line from the foot, L34 (JP2 0082), where this copy already has «167°», the 1 in a heavier sort than the 6 and the 7; p. 62, the 2nd line from the foot, L37 (JP2 0094; AK07-CN057); p. 66, note 1 (JP2 0098, N01; AK07-CN283); p. 92, the 19th line from the foot, L22 (JP2 0124; AK07-CN072); p. 100, L09 and L10 (JP2 0132; AK07-CN284, AK07-CN285); p. 120, Tab. 9, the sign of the anomaly of Saturn at 60 days, L29 (JP2 0152; AK07-CN286); p. 131, Tab. 20, note 7, N04 (JP2 0163; AK07-CN109); p. 145, Tab. 34, note 1, N01 (JP2 0177; AK07-CN287). The critical notes AK07-CN016, CN036, CN043, CN044, CN045, CN057, CN072 and CN109 rest on the evidence of their own pages, the others on this list; the error of p. 120 is also shown by the arithmetic of its column.

critical_notes.evidence: «statt» in every other entry of the list; one t is printed
the abbreviation «v. u.» is set in roman in every other entry, as «Z. 7 v. u.» in the line above; the v is printed in bold type
